title: Good-Faith Percentage Schedule by Days Past Due — Home Purchase Financing
content:
**Hardship percentage schedule — Home Purchase Financing good-faith payments**

The good-faith percentage is the percentage of the principal and interest past due that a good-faith payment represents. Where the oldest unpaid installment is 30 or more days past due on the payment date, the good-faith percentage is 40 percent; where it is 15 to 29 days past due, the good-faith percentage is 30 percent. Where it is fewer than 15 days past due, no raised percentage applies under this schedule.

Days past due are counted in calendar days from the oldest unpaid installment's due date to the payment date, never below zero.

| Days past due on the payment date | Good-faith percentage |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 40 percent |
| 15 to 29 | 30 percent |
| fewer than 15 | no raised percentage |

### Boundary cases (oldest unpaid installment due 2026-03-01, hypothetical)

| Payment date | Days past due | Good-faith percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-31 | 30 | 40 percent |
| 2026-03-30 | 29 | 30 percent |
| 2026-03-16 | 15 | 30 percent |
| 2026-03-15 | 14 | no raised percentage |
